newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech IPB cuts base rate 1pct to 19pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech IPB cuts base rate 1pct to 19pct.

text.p: Prague-based Investicni a Postovni Banka a.s. said on Wednesday that it would lower its base lending rate on new credit by one percentage point to 19 percent with effect from August 8.
It said the base rate for credits granted before the beginning of 1995 woud also fall by one percentage point to 23 percent.
The move is concurrent with rate reductions at other major Czech banks, and follows a general downward trend in rates on the interbank market.
